verdict.rationale: The SAM.gov documentation is a static reference: it lists parameters with example values and offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec. Nothing shows an interactive in-page console or runnable 'try it' examples. Its advice to make calls from a browser or Postman is a user-side workaround, and the OpenAPI file is only a building block, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable examples inside the docs, and hands-on corroboration of either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Users can make GET calls using any Browser or a Restful API client such as Postman.
the Entity Management API documentation carries an OpenAPI Specification File section with the downloadable spec.
